summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K announcing the monetary adjustment and payment of the second installment of shareholder remuneration for the 2025 fiscal year, specifically interest on capital with a Selic rate adjustment. The payment date is June 22, 2026, with a record date of April 22, 2026. ADR holders will receive payment on June 29, 2026. This is a routine dividend/interest on capital distribution, not a special situation event. No strategic review, acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing is a standard periodic report on shareholder payments, mapping to a US dividend declaration and payment notice.
